nodes.norm_label: linked repo: seat-tracker-app (mandatory, cannot be overridden)

nodes.label: eBileta Cart Row data-item JSON (staId, eveId, codice, dataInizio)
nodes.norm_label: ebileta cart row data-item json (staid, eveid, codice, datainizio)

nodes.label: Notification Buttons (Open map, Scan again, Mark done, Stop, Listing)
nodes.norm_label: notification buttons (open map, scan again, mark done, stop, listing)
nodes.rationale: Listing button replaces Open map because ntfy allows 3 buttons and Chrome 2.

nodes.label: Extras Loop (Choose from List + Repeat with Each)
nodes.norm_label: extras loop (choose from list + repeat with each)

nodes.label: Seat fields helper Shortcut
nodes.rationale: Add and Edit share the same loop; keep it in one place.

nodes.label: Top Menu (Choose from Menu: Seat Tracker)
nodes.norm_label: top menu (choose from menu: seat tracker)

nodes.label: Build the Text, Send Once pattern
nodes.norm_label: build the text, send once pattern
nodes.rationale: Topic written once, one send block, no Safari page (Get Contents of URL), URL Encode removes link rules.

nodes.label: Quiet Hours (with let-through for Tickets available now)
nodes.norm_label: quiet hours (with let-through for tickets available now)

nodes.label: Face value tab (eFinity / Posttick vs viagogo)
nodes.norm_label: face value tab (efinity / posttick vs viagogo)

nodes.label: Read the whole stadium (preview before tracking)
nodes.norm_label: read the whole stadium (preview before tracking)
nodes.rationale: Kept on this PC for an hour, nothing sent to the team because there is no event yet.

nodes.label: viagogo event drawer
nodes.rationale: viagogo shows each seller a relative price, so the drawer ranks display prices rather than computing real ones.

nodes.label: Team prices on untracked viagogo events
nodes.norm_label: team prices on untracked viagogo events
nodes.rationale: Parked because team_prices view does not expose vg_event_id; plan: add it to view, carry through toTeamPrice, background teamPrices, and teamAt.

nodes.label: Team view per event
nodes.rationale: Stops two people dumping the same sector; natural home for the other team ideas.

nodes.label: Undercut alert
nodes.rationale: Being undercut costs money and is common; needs a scan, so it belongs with the drawer not the service worker.

nodes.label: Import JSON from three old trackers
nodes.norm_label: import json from three old trackers

nodes.label: Polite request queue (one at a time, 0.8 s apart)
nodes.norm_label: polite request queue (one at a time, 0.8 s apart)

nodes.label: Popup (Listings, Events, Settings, Phone, Account, Backup)
nodes.norm_label: popup (listings, events, settings, phone, account, backup)

nodes.label: Supabase shared database (schema.sql)
nodes.rationale: Publishable key is public by design; every table is behind the members list (team.sql kept out of git).

nodes.label: Test suite (unit, PGlite schema, Chrome browser tests)
nodes.norm_label: test suite (unit, pglite schema, chrome browser tests)

nodes.label: Updates: shared version link to every PC
nodes.norm_label: updates: shared version link to every pc
nodes.rationale: Unzip over same folder because Chrome identifies unpacked extension by folder; PCs notified only when shared version exceeds manifest version.

nodes.label: viagogo last sales (vg_last_sales, just-sold toast)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately slow (45-75 s between requests) with 6-hour team-wide pause on bot checks; never solves the check itself.

nodes.label: Message inbox in the popup
nodes.rationale: Team notes vanish after push; already stored in alerts table (type teamNote), read via Remote.alertsSince.

nodes.label: Scan lease (one PC scans an event)
nodes.norm_label: scan lease (one pc scans an event)
nodes.rationale: Prevents two PCs scanning the same event at once; failing PC drops the lease for another to take over.

nodes.label: Team sharing model (shared / yours / this PC)
nodes.norm_label: team sharing model (shared / yours / this pc)
nodes.rationale: Events and scans shared so one PC scans for all; requests, alerts, topics stay per person; requests judged one by one, never summed.

nodes.label: Phone Notification Channel (ntfy)
nodes.rationale: No server sends notifications; they only work while Chrome runs on some awake team PC.

nodes.label: Sector sweep (untracked sectors, eBileta)
nodes.rationale: Scans only read sectors with requests, so stands released near the date would go unnoticed; Soldout sectors never read.

nodes.label: content/act.js write boundary
nodes.rationale: Every synthetic event dispatched from one file; test fails if another site script grows one.

nodes.label: eFinity Bar Table sector (BARSKI STO)
nodes.rationale: Each table is its own article; a table counts only if every seat is free because eFinity will not sell fewer than four of six.

nodes.label: Holding seats (opt-in seat selection)
nodes.rationale: Only write action; off by default per PC; requires real click, max 12/min, logged; never pays or checks out; scans stand aside while holding.

nodes.label: Profit, win rate and break-even (in lek)
nodes.norm_label: profit, win rate and break-even (in lek)

nodes.label: Reading viagogo listings (my.viagogo.com/listings)
nodes.rationale: Nothing on viagogo is clicked and viagogo is never contacted in the background.

nodes.label: Display to real price calibration
nodes.rationale: Median ratio of display to real price over own listings per event would allow honest ranking across sellers.

nodes.label: Request status (OK / LOW / SPLIT / SHORT / BOUGHT / NOT SCANNED)
nodes.norm_label: request status (ok / low / split / short / bought / not scanned)

nodes.label: Blocks and options (seat adjacency by position)
nodes.norm_label: blocks and options (seat adjacency by position)
nodes.rationale: Blocks from seat positions, never seat numbers; aisle = gap wider than 1.75x row spacing; options = sum floor(block/tickets).

nodes.label: Per-PC notification mode (Silent / Follow mine / Its own)
nodes.norm_label: per-pc notification mode (silent / follow mine / its own)
nodes.rationale: Every PC starts silent so shared or always-on machines do not show someone's alerts.

nodes.label: Serialized storage writes via service worker
nodes.norm_label: serialized storage writes via service worker
nodes.rationale: Popup, sidebars, commands and auto-checks never overwrite each other; between PCs first to record wins, preventing duplicate alerts.

nodes.label: Site adapter contract (core/registry.js)
nodes.rationale: Adapter only returns plain seats {row,label,x,y,free,cat,id}; everything else works unchanged.

nodes.label: Command Link Format (ntfy publish URL, key=value args)
nodes.norm_label: command link format (ntfy publish url, key=value args)

nodes.label: Shortcuts Topic (ntfy command channel)
nodes.rationale: Must be kept secret: anyone who knows it can add, change and delete requests. Empty turns commands off.

nodes.label: One-tap Shortcuts (Home Screen, widget, Siri, Back Tap)
nodes.norm_label: one-tap shortcuts (home screen, widget, siri, back tap)

nodes.label: Send Block (URL Encode + Get Contents of URL)
nodes.norm_label: send block (url encode + get contents of url)

nodes.label: Command Polling (30s, 10-min expiry, max 10 per check)
nodes.norm_label: command polling (30s, 10-min expiry, max 10 per check)
nodes.rationale: Commands older than 10 minutes are skipped so commands sent while the computer slept are not replayed; each runs exactly once, oldest first.

nodes.label: edit command
nodes.rationale: Editing starts a fresh alert baseline, so the edit itself never alerts.

nodes.label: Change-only Alerting (fresh baseline, what never notifies)
nodes.norm_label: change-only alerting (fresh baseline, what never notifies)
nodes.rationale: Every alert is about a change on the site; first scans, own edits, done requests and NOT SCANNED never alert.

nodes.label: Confirm No Longer Fillable (two scans in a row)
nodes.norm_label: confirm no longer fillable (two scans in a row)
nodes.rationale: Avoids false alarms when seats are briefly held in a cart (timeline A).

nodes.label: Repeat Warnings Until Stop (15 min)
nodes.rationale: A problem that lasts is worse than one that starts; reminders bypass mute and quiet hours, Stop ends them per person without marking done.

nodes.label: Messages Between Teammates (Tell the team)
nodes.rationale: The only hand-started notification; nothing else about the team is sent automatically.

nodes.label: Notification Privacy (no client names, secret topics)
nodes.norm_label: notification privacy (no client names, secret topics)

nodes.label: Per-person Request Ownership and Alert Routing
nodes.norm_label: per-person request ownership and alert routing
nodes.rationale: Requests are never added up; other people's requests are invisible to you.

nodes.label: Send-once Dedup via Shared Database
nodes.rationale: PC records new status in shared DB before alerting; if another PC recorded it first it stays quiet, so awake PCs never double-alert and waking PCs do not resend old alerts.

nodes.label: New Event on a Site
nodes.rationale: First check only records existing events so installing does not send a flood.

nodes.label: A Sector With No Seats Now Has Some
nodes.norm_label: a sector with no seats now has some

nodes.label: Sector Sweep (eBileta, per event)
nodes.rationale: Skips sectors the site labels sold out because sweeping them every 30 min would cost more than everything else; per-event because matches release stands differently.

nodes.label: Ticket/Seat Icon Design (blue ticket on dark rounded square with green status dot)
nodes.norm_label: ticket/seat icon design (blue ticket on dark rounded square with green status dot)
nodes.rationale: Blue ticket shape with notched sides symbolizes a seat/ticket; green dot in the bottom-right corner signals an active/available tracking status. Dark navy rounded-square background keeps contrast at small toolbar sizes.

nodes.label: Reply from the phone (ntfy buttons to cmdTopic)
nodes.norm_label: reply from the phone (ntfy buttons to cmdtopic)

nodes.label: Request Status (OK / LOW / SPLIT / SHORT / NOT SCANNED)
nodes.norm_label: request status (ok / low / split / short / not scanned)
